request.label: r3-freeze-fourfold-matrix
command:
from pathlib import Path
import json, sys
from resources import atomic, identity
from task2r_run import require

root = Path(sys.argv[1])
source = root / "evidence/r3-time-matrix.json"
require(identity(source)["sha256"] == "b23684e5bdc09056b2302c0a2d3596c516b7084e199a33172642079309f3a72b",
        "frozen physical comparison matrix differs")
prior = json.loads(source.read_text())
proof = root / "evidence/r3-time-perturbed-1-fd-fourfold.json"
value = json.loads(proof.read_text())
require(value["status"] == "PASS" and value["accepted_steps"] == 4 and value["final_time"] == .08,
        "fourfold matrix requires both signed endpoints")
levels = []
for row in prior["levels"]:
    label = row["label"] + "-fd-fourfold"
    updated = dict(row, label=label, fd_step=4e-6)
    if label == "r3-time-perturbed-1-fd-fourfold":
        updated.update(operation_cap_seconds=1960, maximum_pause_seconds=150)
    levels.append(updated)
atomic(root / "evidence/r3-fourfold-matrix.json", dict(schema="WJH27R3FourfoldMatrixV1",
    original=identity(source), first_signed=identity(proof), source_binding=identity(root/"evidence/r3-timed-parity.json"),
    represented_signed_state=identity(root/"science-r3/r3-audit-timed-perturbation/audit.json"),
    fd_step=4e-6, common_times=[.04,.08], levels=levels,
    finer_witness=prior["finer_witness"], evaluation=prior["evaluation"],
    confirmed_coarse_signed_seconds=value["timing"]["charge_seconds"],
    cost_basis="Retain the frozen clock, output and resource limits for the other levels until their measured receipts settle."))
